SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, LEGACY_GR_NO FROM ZKEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY PLANT, LEGACY_GR_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'LTCO' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , UNIT_PRICE , CURRENCY_CODE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , GR_DATE , LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ , DELY_TO_LOCATION , REMARK FROM ZKEP_GR WHERE LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT,LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ,LEGACY_PO_NO,LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE ZKEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , IF_TINME = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),108),':','') WHERE LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
